description: This file contains C source code implementing functions for initializing, retrieving data from, and uninitializing an rbus interface within a RDM (Remote Device Management) context. It includes functions like rdmRbusInit, rdmRbusGetRfc, and rdmRbusUnInit, along with associated error handling and external dependencies.

methods.name: INT32 rdmRbusInit(VOID ** pRDMRbusHandle,INT8 * rbusName)
methods.description: Initializes the rbus handle using the provided rbus name. Checks if rbus is active, opens the rbus connection, and returns success or failure status.

methods.name: INT32 rdmRbusGetRfc(VOID * plRDMRbusHandle,INT8 * rdmRFCName,VOID * pValue)
methods.description: Retrieves RFC details from rbus, including enabling status and URL string, based on the RFC name. Handles different rbus value types and performs error checking.

methods.name: VOID rdmRbusUnInit(VOID * pRDMbusHandle)
methods.description: Uninitializes the rbus handle by closing the connection, with error handling for invalid handles.
